name: J. R. Fegan
role: Acting Northern Pacific station agent at Medora, 1884
bio: J. R. Fegan served as acting station agent at Medora in October 1884 while agent Brinker was on leave. In November 1884 he exchanged places with Mr. Maxwell of the car accountant's office in Mandan.

moments.label: Became acting agent during Brinker's leave

mentions: …gent, has obtained a month's leave of absence, and has gone on a visit to his home in Pennsylvania. Mr. J. R. Fegan will act as agent until his return.
H. G. Sharkey, travelling auditor of the N. P. R. R. is here looking over agent Fegan's books.
…rator, and Mr. Maxwell, formerly in the car accountant's office in Mandan, exchanges places to-day with agent Fegan.
